item.description:
- Update the customized app to the 0.73.0 stable source while retaining the Control Center, usage statistics, and run-out forecast.

- Remove the warning-colored chart frame after pointer selection; retain keyboard focus and accessible navigation.

- Avoid optimized timer crashes during menu-bar refreshes and while opening Settings.

- Add signed personal-fork updates from GitHub, with Check for Updates in About and the Control Center actions.

- Preserve account-scoped usage, source accounting, and accurate 30-day widget totals.

- Dim stale quota colors consistently while keeping high-contrast readouts fully visible.

- Retain Pi's 30-day totals after empty refreshes and identify partial widget history as a lower bound.

This personal fork is ad-hoc code signed and is not Apple notarized. Sparkle verifies its signed updates.
